brief.context: A small quality console: volume, nulls, duplicates, and a sample of failing rows. Grounded in tables you name, or the demo CSV.
enables: KPI row for row count / nulls / duplicates
Nulls-by-column chart and a detail table
Disconnected demo on the fixture pack

Replace a full DQ platform or dbt tests suite

questions.help: e.g. the steward on-call, the analytics engineer
